One casing. A stationary hub.

Accepted motion and energy

What this control establishes

The hub is fixed by the model's joint structure. The casing retains its springs, edge viscosity, gravity and flat frictionless contact. The clamp can exert force and moment but does no work.

Persistent motion here can occur without rider or suspension feedback. Neither persistence nor decay alone establishes the cause, calibrated damping or stable idle. Travel/deformation limits stop unsupported states; they are not fracture or blowout predictions.
